scorecards.inningsCommentary: India commenced their first innings at Sir Vivian Richards Stadium, aiming to set an imposing baseline total. The centerpiece of the innings was a brilliant 81 from Ajinkya Rahane, complemented by a commanding 82-run stand between GH Vihari and Ajinkya Rahane that absorbed bowling hostility and accelerated the scoring rate to 3.06 RPO. West Indies's bowling response was spearheaded by KAJ Roach (4/66), who generated sustained pressure and triggered critical breakthroughs to prevent runaway scoring. Concluding at 297/10 (96.4 ov), India posted a competitive total, ensuring a closely matched contest.

India's bowling response was spearheaded by Jasprit Bumrah (5/7), who generated sustained pressure and triggered critical breakthroughs to prevent runaway scoring. Dismissed for 100/10 (26.5 ov), West Indies succumbed to fourth-innings pressure as India's bowlers closed out the victory.

summaryTab.matchCommentary:
The Test match at Sir Vivian Richards Stadium commenced with high tactical intensity as India posted 297/10 (96.4 ov) in their opening innings. In response, West Indies countered with 222/10 (74.2 ov), setting the stage for a compelling contest of tactical endurance. Early sessions tested batting resolve against disciplined seam movement, with both attacks striving to gain the upper hand on a developing surface.

The defining turning point arrived during Century: Ajinkya Rahane 102 (242b), which irrevocably altered the trajectory of the match. As the match progressed through its pivotal middle stages, Ajinkya Rahane delivered a masterclass for India (183 Runs), absorbing intense pressure and tilting the momentum decisively. Crucial partnership stands and incisive bowling spells broke the opposition's resistance, shifting the control share (India 51%) and allowing India to dictate terms heading into the decisive sessions.

Entering the final innings, West Indies faced an uphill battle under unrelenting scoreboard pressure. India's bowling unit, bolstered by RL Chase (60 Runs & 6 Wkts), maintained relentless discipline and attacked the stumps relentlessly. Wicket clusters in the closing sessions dismantled any remaining resistance, sealing India won by 318 runs in comprehensive fashion.

Verdict: India's triumph was built on superior pressure absorption, clinical execution during critical moments, and the ability to dominate key sessions. While West Indies produced fighting phases, India won the pivotal turning points and sustained higher tactical control across all five days to emerge as deserved victors.
